propositions: Provide read-only, deterministic derivations over git history and the working tree for git-derivable code-health metrics.
module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py at a ref against the single-sourced hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt, returning count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc.
cap_change_events returns a list[dict] of old_limit/new_limit changes from the limit file's git log, returning [] for ranges with no change.
churn sums insertions and deletions from git log --numstat, and refactor_to_addition_ratio returns deletions/insertions or None when insertions is 0.
Each of the four raw functions is registered into the c085 REGISTRY as a MetricSpec via a single-arg context adapter with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high.
Metrics derive from the current single flat admin-locked hard cap mechanism, not the deleted per-file ceilings ratchet.
